input.quote: This Agreement and the license granted under this Agreement shall remain in effect perpetually as long as fees are paid by Sparkling in accordance with the Fee Schedule and the Agreement is not otherwise terminated in accordance with this Section.
input.rationale: There is no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall charge or volume restriction on Sparkling; fees are simply those in the Fee Schedule and maintenance can be exited via the 90-day convenience right. Matches our preferred position.

input.quote: Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 imposes exit obligations on us only; there is no transition assistance, no return of Sparkling data held by Garman (which handles our data conversion) and no deletion certification. We proposed a short Section 17(d) providing up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in machine-readable form and certified deletion thereafter.
